program: Whole-gift cost; supported hearing-aid health quantified

nutshell.headline: Low historical expense, but the return depends on unmeasured treatment volume and persistence
nutshell.body: A $10,000 whole gift yields 0.10664 prior-weighted Bay QALYs, or $937,721 per10. This is a prior-driven exploratory hypothesis, not measured or purchasable health impact.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Refurbished devices, clinical fitting and donated professional resources can lower barriers for people otherwise unable to obtain hearing care.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Annual unique treatment offers are unknown; 91.8% of signed expectation comes from the10% favorable world.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: HOLD a giving recommendation. Verify unique completed fits, support, actual alternative-care timing and what new funding changes. Unknowns permit transparent modeling, not a claim of verified cost-effectiveness.

programSection.body: EIN81-2591375. Pacific Hearing Connection provides low-cost hearing care, including refurbished aids and fitting, in the Bay Area. It is separate from Pacific Hearing Service, which contributes space; clinical time and devices also have opportunity costs.

steps.title: Retain whole organization cost
steps.detail: All historical expense remains in the denominator, including outreach, administration and inventory adjustment.

steps.title: Model deduplicated person-course offers
steps.detail: 30/75/150 annual offers are explicit judgments, not screenings, bilateral devices or observed completed patients.

steps.title: Complete treatment and sustain incremental benefit
steps.detail: Completion converts offered courses to fits; effective years include ramp, nonuse and alternative-care catch-up.

steps.title: Count Bay health and independent harms
steps.detail: MostlyBay is qualitative;85/95/99% are priors. Incremental harms are subtracted before residence allocation.

programSection.boundary: Only hearing-aid health quantified; other diagnostic/education benefits remain unquantified. Whole accounting expense is not complete societal resources. Do not credit the same outcome again to funders, suppliers, supporting practice or another hearing charity.

model.headline: $937,721 per10 modeled Bay QALYs
model.body: The accepted Ear of the Lion model also lacks measured annual courses. PHC is therefore modeled under the same exploratory standard, with independently stated throughput and geography judgments; common clinical/funding priors prevent silent favorable transfer.

equation.label: Signed Bay health
equation.expression: gift / whole expense × annual person-course offers × funding response × (utility × clinical transfer × completion × effective incremental years − harm per offer) × Bay share
